svg.title: CorrFlow: step-wise correction and lightweight refiner
svg.desc: Side-by-side overview and refiner architecture. Three print sizes: 8 pt bold panel titles, 6.5 pt bold component labels and regular data labels and mathematics, and 5.5 pt annotations, at a physical width of 5.5 inches. Mathematical glyphs are typeset with pdfLaTeX and Computer Modern, following the manuscript notation.
